svg.title: Finder Fee Ceilings by State
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-07-finder-fee-ceilings; chapter number: 4; title: Finder Fee Ceilings by State; subtitle: Reported caps across four state walkthroughs (percent); chart type: stacked_comparison; total range: 10% to 40% finder fee ceilings across reported states; buckets: label: New York; low: 15; high: 15; notes: Capped at 15% with a written, notarized contract; the state sends 100% of the check to the owner.; label: Kansas; low: 15; high: 15; notes: 15% ceiling; Kansas intercepts delinquent state taxes, child support, and court fines and pays only the net.; label: Georgia; low: 10; high: 30; notes: Reported range of 10% to 30% depending on agent type.; label: Montana; low: 10; high: 40; notes: Reported range of 10% to 40%; the state auto-mails up to $1,000 without a formal claim.; caption: Finder ceilings split widely by state even though every portal runs on the same free search engine.; assumptions note: Single-value caps are shown with equal low and high; ranges are as reported and may reflect different agent categories.; note: Attributed to Как се прави (New York); GardenShop.Pro (Kansas, Georgia, Montana); WFAA; KHOU 11.
